title: Q-MTC-breach-path: breach detection and notification path
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every executor run
**Done check:** grep:seed/autonomy/failure-modes.json::"id": "tenant-data-breach"
**Status:** closed

Multi-tenant control `breach-path` is unproven: breach detection and notification path. Needed: a failure mode `tenant-data-breach` with a detector and a notification step that reaches the affected tenant's contact. The hosted tier stays closed until this is proven. Source: doctrine/tenant-controls.json (TENANT-CONTROLS-1).

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 26.7 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
